title: How a Godly Man Takes the Job Nobody Wants Before He Ever Leads One
caption:
The guys who lead well almost always did the job nobody wanted first.

Volunteer before you're assigned. Absorb the cost without announcing it. Let someone else take the credit sometimes and watch what that does to your motive.

Christ washed feet before He led anyone anywhere. Nobody skips that step and keeps their integrity.

The man who leads first into the cost is the only one worth following into it.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #leadership #service
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
